g.text: (UCM discovery + scenario synthesis from a process tree)
Definitions vs References — the URN duality
Each domain concept exists once as a URN-level
(Responsibility / ComponentElement) and zero or more times as
resp_def and cont_def are the back-pointers; cont_ref on a
PathNode declares which component rectangle visually contains it.
case-constant attribute mined from the log (data-driven).
per loop operator in the tree —
the per-loop counter driving the LoopFork/LoopEntryGuard.
s on OR-forks are set by the synthesizer
in the same call and are what jUCMNav evaluates at runtime.
